title.rendered: How to Buy Air Conditioner Based on Star Ratings for your needs?

content.rendered:
The air conditioner is a cooling device which is found in almost all houses these days. You will hardly see any house, without an air conditioner. The best part of the air conditioners is you can adjust the room temperature according to your choice, irrespective of the season. That means you will be able to make your room temperature a little higher than what is it is outside in the winter and rainy seasons. While at the same time, in the summer, you will be able to make the temperature less than what it is outside. That means you will be able to get the room temperature of your choice between 16 to 30. Almost all the Latest Air Conditioners are having these temperature settings. Your air conditioner is going to be the best Air conditioner if you are able to buy the best one with all the features that you need in an Air conditioner. Almost all the air conditioners these days are having all the latest features.

Tips For Money Saving When You Are Buying An Air Conditioner

When you are purchasing an air conditioner, you will have to take care of a lot of things. Below are a few tips that can help you in saving some money. When you are following these tips, you will not just save money when you are buying an air conditioner, but you will also be able to save some money when you are using it also. That means you will be able to save some money on your electricity bill. That is the best part of these tips. Please have a look at the tips here:

Select The Right BTU Value For You

There are many people who have bought an air conditioner and are using them as well. But not many of them are even aware or heard the word BTU. BTU stands for British Thermal Units. This is the factor which is going to describe the cooling capacity of the air conditioner and the power of the air conditioner as well. If the BTU value of the air conditioner is high, then the cooling capacity of the air conditioner is also high. You will be able to see that the BTU value of any air conditioner is going to vary from 5000 BTU’s to 30000 BTU’s. If you are not choosing the BTU value in the right way, then you will have to face a lot of problems. Your BTU value is wrong, then it will not be able to do what it is meant to do in the room when you switch it on. So, whatever is the type of the air conditioner, you will have to make sure that you are choosing the right BTU value for your air conditioner and that can help in using the air conditioner in the right way.

Brand Of Your Air Conditioner

The next important factor that you should keep in mind when you are buying an air conditioner is the brand of the air conditioner. Always make sure that the brand of your air conditioner is chosen in the right way. Check the features of an air conditioner when you are buying it. Have certain features in mind that you are looking for in your air conditioner that you are going to buy. You may be able to find the same features in differently branded air conditioners. But do you really think that you can go for any brand when you are able to get the same features? That is going to save you some money as well. That is not the right way to choose an air conditioner. The brand really speaks and when you are buying the right brand at the right price, you will be able to save some money now and after you buy and start using it as well.

Finally, The Model Of The Air Conditioner

Yes, the model of the air conditioner also plays a very important role. You will be able to find different air conditioners in different sizes and also in different options. You will be able to choose the features of the air conditioner as well. The more interesting features that you are looking for, the more will be its price. But you should always make sure that you are buying the model which is having all the features that you are looking for. If you are buying an air conditioner with multiple features, then you will be able to save some money. So, these are the basic tips that can help you in saving some money. That means the first thing to concentrate is the BTU value of the air conditioner, the second is the brand of the air conditioner and the last one is the model of the air conditioner. Check out the different models that you have in the store. You will be able to find some models with different kinds of designs on them. Hence you will be able to find the best air conditioner with all the features that you were looking for. It can sometimes be tough to choose the right brand when there are so many brands available in the market. But if you can do some homework and then start your air conditioner shopping, then you will be able to save some money and time as well. You will be able to find online reviews about the air conditioner and this kind of reviews are given by the real-time users of the air conditioner. So, there can be nothing much better than these reviews for selecting an air conditioner. This way you will be able to find the best model and save some bucks.

Different Air Conditioner Ratings

When you go to buy an air conditioner, you will hear from the sales executive about the air conditioner ratings. What are these ratings? When you are looking for an air conditioner, then there is a lot of information that you need to gather before you buy one. Whether it is a home air conditioner or for your office, you will have to do some research about it. Whenever you are able to buy the right air conditioner, then its efficiency is going to be high and you will be happy for every penny that you have spent on the air conditioner.

Here is a list of a few ratings used in the air conditioners:

EER – Energy Efficient Ratio

The Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Institute or ARI first establishes this ratio.

This rating was first given in the year 1975.

This rating has helped the manufacturer to describe the cooling efficiency.

By looking at just the specification, the seller or the manufacturer will be able to understand the cooling efficiency of the air conditioner.

When you are buying an air conditioner, then you will have to make sure that this EER rating is high.

When the value of the EER is high, then that means that the air conditioner is having good efficiency.

If you are comparing two air conditioners, then you will have to choose the one that is having a higher EER value among those two.

There are a few drawbacks with this EER rating and hence they came up with another kind of rating and that is SEER rating.

SEER – Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio

Air Conditioning, Heating and Refrigeration Institute was the first to give this SEER rating.

The non-steady states are not considered in the EER ratings and this rating was made to overcome that factor.

The steady state conditions like the startup and also the shutdown cycles are also considered.

This rating is going to take the outside temperature also into consideration before the rating is given.

Energy Star Rating

Environmental Protection Agency first started using this Energy Star Rating.

This is going to help you know the energy required by different kinds of air conditioners available in the market.

So, you will be able to decide which the right air conditioner for your needs is and hence you will be able to buy the best one.

About The Air Conditioner Labels

You will be able to see the star ratings on the air conditioners when you reach any store for buying the air conditioners.

What are actually these energy star ratings?

This is one of the common questions that are asked by many people.

You will be able to see this on almost all the air conditioner.

The sales executive will try to explain something regarding these ratings to you and you hardly understand that terminology.

So, for those who did not understand that terminology, here is some information in some simple words.

 

What are Star Ratings?

For all those who really have no idea about what is the star rating, here is some information for you. These star ratings are basically developed with the help of the people who are using the air conditioners. You will be able to compare all the models that are present in the showroom. You will know the efficiency of the air conditioner with the help of these star ratings. So, when you are seeing so many models of air conditioners, just see the star rating to compare them.  

Advantages Of Star Ratings

There are so many advantages that you will be able to enjoy with the help of the star ratings that are given by the manufacturers.
  • When you are having a good star rating on the air conditioner, then you will be able to see that the air conditioner is using less energy and hence that is going to save you some money.
 
  • When the star rating is high, then you can consider that the air conditioner is environmental friendly as well. That means they will not damage the environment as much as it is done by other low star rated air conditioners.
 
  • You will be able to see that the air conditioner with high star ratings will give you a good cooling effect for you. You will also be able to save on your power bills as well.

The Stars Speaks

You will be able to find two kinds of stars on the air conditioner. One of them is in blue colour while the other kind of them is in red colour. The blue stars one is going to represent the cooling function of the air conditioner. While the red stars are going to denote the heating function of the air conditioner. Unless and until you are buying a device which is a just cooling device, you will be able to find both the ratings. You will not be able to find the red ratings. When the number of stars on the air conditioner is high, then the air conditioner is more efficient. You will have an air conditioner which is having 10 stars. If the air conditioner is having six stars or more, then you will be able to see an extra rating and that is the super efficiency rating band, just above the normal stars. In the picture that you can see above, you will be able to see that there is an extra arch that is showing its efficiency. You will be able to compare the efficiency of a different air conditioner with the help of the stars that you are seeing on the air conditioner. It is really easy to compare the air conditioner models with the help of these ratings. You need not to have to do too much extra work for comparing two different models of air conditioners that are available in the market nowadays.  

Power Input And The Capacity Output

If you want to know the heating capacity and the cooling capacity of an air conditioner, then you will have to take a look at the capacity values of it. This is one of the best ways to compare the air conditioners when you find two air conditioners with the same star rating. Yes, can be really tough for you to decide which one to buy, when those two look almost the same and when they are the same price. So, with the help of the capacity output value, you will be able to decide which air conditioner to buy. The power Input value is also used for comparing the two air conditioners when the star value is the same. This is going to show how much input power is required by the air conditioner for giving the required cooling or heating effect in the room. So, when you are having the same star rating, then you can go for the capacity output value comparison. But what if these two values are the same? Then you will have to go with the power input value. When the power input value is low, then you can consider that air conditioner. That means the capacity output value should be high while comparison and the power input value should be low while choosing an air conditioner.

The Size Plays An Important Role

When you are choosing an air conditioner for your house or for your office. You should be checking so many things like the models, brand, BTU, star ratings, designs, colours and a few more. But there is one important thing that you generally miss. The size of the room is one important factor on which all these stars and ratings depend on. Yes, you will have to decide the EER and the SEER based on the size of the room. When you go to any store for buying the air conditioner, you will not generally check the size of your room. You will just go to a store and when the sales executive asks you for the size of the room, and then you give some approximate values to them. That is not the way you should be given the size and buy an air conditioner. You should give the size on the feet and then based on that the sales executive will be able to decide the model that can be right for you. Whether it is a master bedroom which is usually big or a normal bedroom, you are going to call it a bedroom. But the capacity output and the power input will definitely vary from them. A bigger room needs more power input to maintain the temperature that they want in the room. So, you should consider the size of the room while buying an air conditioner.

The Material Used For Making The Room Also Matters

A room which is made of bricks is definitely different from the room that is made using the glass. Yes, you will see a lot of difference in both the room when you are installing an air conditioner in that room. So, a room made of glass with need more power for making the room cool and also for maintaining the temperature that you desire. That means, the glass room will keep absorbing the heat inside and hence you will have to manage it. But a room made with the brick does not need so much power to cool the room or you maintain the temperature.

The Insulation Levels Of The Room

If the insulation levels of the room are good enough, then it is easy to maintain the temperature of the room as you desired. You need not to have to take too much stress for it. But if the insulation levels are low, then it is going to consume a lot of energy for maintaining the temperature.

Windows And Their Direction Also Is Important

If there are a number of windows in the room, then there is more chance that the temperature goes high and you will have to run the air conditioner for a longer time. You will not be able to maintain the temperature for a long time and hence you need to run it for a longer time.

Climate Of The Place You Live In

The climatic conditions of the place where you are living are also very important. While the basic temperature outside is always high, it can be really tough to maintain the star ratings that are given. That means the air conditioner that you are choosing should be capable enough to cope up with the temperature that is outside the room. You will have to understand the air conditioner in the right way in order to use it and maintain it in the right way.

Air Conditioners, Best For Your Weather

The technology is developing so well and fasts these days that you will soon be able to buy an air conditioner that is not going to work the same way in every place. You will be able to buy something that is going to work based on the climate conditions in which you are living. BEE has made some new ratings and that is going to take into account the climatic conditions of different places to show the ratings. You will not have to wait too long for getting this kind of air conditioners. The air conditioners should perform really well, even in the high temperature in the city. Our ISEER has given details about the different climatic conditions in different areas of the country. You will now be able to choose your air conditioner based on these ratings. You will be able to see that the air conditioners that you choose based on these ratings will definitely be energy efficient and you will not have to spend too much on the power bills.

Choose The Right Air Conditioners Based On The Suitable Ratings

So, when you are having so many different kinds of ratings to compare two air conditioners and then choose an air conditioner. You will have to choose all the aspects very carefully and make sure that you are choosing the right one. You will have all the ratings given by the manufacturer when you are having a look at the device. All you will have to do just compare the ratings that are available in front of you and then buy the one that you feel is right for you. That means, you will be able to choose the right one and you should always do some homework and then reach the showroom for buying the air conditioner. If you are visiting the store without any homework, then you will end up buying the wrong air conditioner. You are spending a lot of money on an air conditioner and hence you need to be very careful when you are buying one for yourself. Check all the possible parameters and if possible take the help of people who have an idea about the ratings and then you should be buying the air conditioner.
